utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: Who is it that wants to raise a preliminary matter? Mr. Groome.

utterances.speaker: MR. GROOME
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. Just briefly. Last week when the Defence filed that very large motion with respect to -- to some recent discoveries that they made, the decision by the Chamber as I recall it was to -- that the filings remain confidential until such time -- at a later time the Chamber would decide what would be made public. On Friday that original filing was withdrawn and a new filing published in its place that is now public. And I'm not sure whether the Chamber has already directed the Registry to extend its ruling over that new filing, but I would ask that the Chamber for the same reasons I articulated last week to -- to give some consideration for the same reasons that I articulated last week to maintaining that document or those filings be confidential until the Chamber issues its decision on it. I do note that someone sent me a -- a newspaper clipping this morning. Apparently the news of this has already leaked out and has caused some tremendous upset down in the region, people who believe that -- that some new information exists about people they love. So I would ask the Chamber to be sensitive to that and perhaps extend its ruling. The other thing, Your Honour, I would ask is that it was a very lengthy motion. The Chamber only gave us a day and a half to respond to it. It was quite a bit of work to accomplish that. Then it was subsequently withdrawn, a new filing of 107 pages in its place. The Prosecution would appreciate at least a track changes version or some indication about what's different about this new filing and some guidance about -- from the Chamber with respect to when it expects a new response and what's the status of the original response that the Prosecution filed last week. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: I'll consider the matters you've raised, Mr. Groome, and give and indication later today. Let the witness be called. Closed session.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE ROBINSON
utterances.text: to be reconvened on Wednesday, the 11th day of March, 2009, at 2.15 p.m.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the hearing adjourned at 2.46 p.m.,
